Author: Vivek Rusia

1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT INDORE  CRA No. 10806 of 2024  (SATISH Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH )
 Dated : 08-04-2025  Mr. Sameer Verma, counsel for the appellant.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Sudeep Bhargava, public prosecutor for the responde Heard on IA No.4925/2025 which is an application for condonation of delay filed under Section 5 of Limitation Act, 1963.
The delay is of 142 days.
Keeping in view the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
Delay in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.
Accordingly, IA No.4925/2025 stands disposed of.
The appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Let record of the court below be requisitioned.

Heard on IA No.4923/2025, which is second application under Section 430 of BNSS for temporary suspension of sentence filed on behalf of appellant - Satish S/o Shri Sukhlal Pawar on the ground of death of his mother on 27.03.2025 and to perform the last rites and rituals.

2. The appellant has been convicted under Section 366 and 376(3) of IPC and sentenced to undergo three years and twenty years RI with fine of Rs.500 and 1000/- respectively with further default stipulations.
3. Learned public prosecutor for State submits that mother of the appellant had died on 27.03.2025.
4. After hearing counsel for the parties, I deem it proper to allow IA No. 2 CRA-10806-2024 4923/2025.

The jail sentence of the appellant shall remain temporary suspended for a period of Fifteen Days (15 days) from the date of his release, subject to his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
The appellant shall surrender immediately after expiry of fifteen days from the date of his release failing which the trial Court shall take steps to secure his arrest, in accordance with law.

It is made clear that during the suspension Satish vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11921908/
1 period, the appellant shall not meet the prosecutrix directly or indirectly as well as by phone call.
